Clean-case UPSIDE capture (real per-window TRUSTED->GATED->recover, measurable IPC gap) demonstrated on REAL hardware for the set-local replacement module.

claims_ledger.text: REFINED real-ChampSim replacement finding (E1, three real results): (1) the prior 'dhat~0' was a STRUCTURAL ChampSim-API bug (missing replacement_cache_fill -> reward saw hits only), now fixed -> dhat is a real nonzero signal; (2) the whole-cache competence gap is REAL and large (learned LIP 34% vs fallback SRRIP-HP 4.8% on xalan); (3) per-window SECRET-RESEEDED dueling cannot resolve it because replacement reward is STATEFUL/path-dependent -- reseeding each epoch destroys the policy-specific cache state DRRIP relies on (fixed leaders resolve it; reseeded leaders give rL~rF). So set-locality is necessary but NOT sufficient: the reward must also be STATELESS, or leaders stable. The synthetic harness's i.i.d. per-decision reward satisfies this; real replacement does not at per-window grain.
evidence_refs: champsim FORCE baselines + reseeded/no-reseed dueling logs
claims_ledger.note: NEW honest contribution. Strengthens/corrects bouncer.tex:855-866 (which vaguely said 'sampling/horizon'). Real, measured. Verifying the reseed-confounding A/B (NORESEED run).

claims_ledger.text: Per-domain mimicry resistance: within a declared region audited at resolution delta_R^min(B) with the secret intact, realized-competence audit detects mimicry that input-OOD monitors miss; strength = secrecy of the sampler.
evidence_refs: results/p4.json (full TPR 1.0 vs S_in 0.0; secrecy ablation TPR-vs-f)
claims_ledger.note: Synthetic. Scoped per-domain by prior run.

claims_ledger.text: A sub-resolution slow-bleed (redistributive) adversary outside the audited domain evades forever; delta_R^min(B) ~ 1/sqrt(B). Named, demonstrated open vulnerability.
claims_ledger.note: Honest limitation, demonstrated synthetic. Do not try to close (math forbids).

claims_ledger.text: The QUALITATIVE headline guarantees are robust to the SHAPE of the controller-collapse curve mu_C (clip/logistic, soft/sharp knee), the reward->IPC map, the fallback floor q0 in [0.4,0.6], and a joint mu_C x IPC change; only exact percentages move. Detection POWER is not constant: it tracks |Delta| and degrades near the crossing, per the sigma_Delta bound (characterized).

E1_keystone.note: FALLBACK (honest negative on the keystone, but three REAL refinements that strengthen the paper). KEYSTONE_REAL=false: no clean real per-window upside-capture trajectory -- per-window secret-reseeded dueling cannot resolve replacement competence. WHY (measured): (1) the prior 'dhat~0' was a ChampSim-API bug (no replacement_cache_fill -> hits-only reward -> dhat==0), now FIXED -> dhat nonzero; (2) whole-cache competence gap is REAL (LIP 33.6% vs SRRIP-HP 4.8% on xalan); (3) the SECRET per-epoch reseed (= the mimicry-resistance mechanism) CONFOUNDS the per-window estimate for the STATEFUL replacement reward (reseeded mean dhat=0.005~noise vs fixed-leader 0.23 resolves) -> set-locality necessary but NOT sufficient; a near-stateless reward is also required. Engineering bugs found+fixed along the way: SRRIP-HP-vs-LIP policy choice, corruption semantics (evict-hottest), an ODR violation (unsynced auditor.h copies linked into one binary corrupted the rng_ -> SIGSEGV). Single-trace (xalancbmk) basis disclosed in text. Raised C_repl_realfinding to defended=2; scoped C_upside_real to synthetic everywhere.

outputs: manuscript threat-model realizability paragraph (pending W1 edit)
E2_realizability.note: OPTION B (honest minimum). Option A (build a co-located ChampSim polluter that steers the REAL controller to sub-resolution harm while dhat>=tau) is a separate research contribution, not feasible in budget on single-core SPEC traces. Verdict: state plainly that real-silicon adversarial STEERING is NOT established; the synthetic harness realizes mimicry/steering via the controllable stress u; the real ChampSim study uses an INJECTED, labelled competence degradation (benign/controlled), not a demonstrated real-HW steering attack. The guarantees hold against ANY in-domain degradation regardless of how it arises -- the open question is attacker REALIZABILITY, not the defense. INVARIANT: abstract/intro must not imply demonstrated real-HW steering (prior run already scoped this; W1 verifies).
